name: chrome-extension-builder
description: Plan, research, design, build, test, and package Chrome Manifest V3 extensions with native specialist skills and an optional local Studio.

interface.longDescription: For developers planning and building Chrome Manifest V3 extensions. Guides research, architecture, interface design, frontend implementation, optional backend integration, testing, security reviews, and release preparation. Produces plans, code, review findings, and packaging guidance in chat. Optional local helpers scaffold, check, and package extension projects and open a planning Studio when the host supports local execution. Publication and store approval require separate verification.
defaultPrompt: Help me plan and build a Chrome extension from my idea.
Design a popup and side panel for my Chrome extension.
Review my extension's permissions and prepare a release checklist.

review.commerce_description: No plugin purchases, subscription, checkout or upsell. Generated extension products are separate.

publication.release_notes: Version 2.2.5 clarifies the Chrome Extension Builder listing with a factual task-based subtitle, description and starter prompts. All native editions retain the same 19 skills, shared policies, independent for Chrome logo and optional local helpers. No MCP or automatic startup was added.
